input.title: Give the Topic select an accessible name
input.rationale: The <select id="topic"> has no accessible name. A visible <label>Topic</label> sits just before it (line 11), but it has no for attribute, so it isn't linked to the select. Setting aria-label="Topic" on the select gives it a name that matches the visible label text. A better fix in the source would be to add for="topic" to that <label>. That way clicking the label also focuses the select, and the name can't fall out of sync with the visible text. I can only edit the select element, so I'm flagging that change for the reviewer. Please check this with assistive technology. This change doesn't confirm the page is compliant.
